crossRefs.note: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

translations.web: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
translations.bsb: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
translations.kjv: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
translations.asv: Therefore is my harp turned to mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.
